profile.headline: Junior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a Software Engineer with a B.S. in Computer Science and Software Engineering, specializing in Cybersecurity, and a minor in Business Administration. I have nearly 2 years of experience developing simulation software at Boeing and over 1 year in full-stack development at T-Mobile. My technical expertise includes C/C++, Java, Python, Microsoft SQL Server, and experience in Linux and Windows environments, GitLab, and Visual Studio Code.

I am passionate about solving complex technical challenges and working in collaborative team settings. Outside of work, I enjoy reading, playing tennis, and Gomoku. I am also a volunteer tutor with Strive2Thrive Edu, supporting marginalized and underserved communities through education. If you are interested in Strive2Thrive Edu, feel free to reach out—I’m happy to answer questions.

projects.title: Countdown timer
projects.description: This is a small personal project that I created mainly just to applied the self-learning Python knowledge along with some basic trigonometry concepts. This program lets you enter the amount of time and then a clock counts down from the input time to 00:00. When the time is up, my favorite song is played a sound to signal that. While the clock is counting down, you can pause the time and resume it, stop the time (and go back to the input) or restart the clock.

projects.title: Flappy Bird game
projects.description: This is a small personal project that I created during summer mainly just to refresh my memory of Java fundamentals. The program is a Flappy Bird game simulator with sound effects.
